I adopted my dog ​​from this place. They told us that the adoption included spaying and vaccinations.

Well, the thing is, we were going to spay her after having her at home for over a month, and my mother decided to ask about the blood test results. It turns out they hadn't done them, not when we got her, nor before, nor after. They anesthetized her, and then she went to get the blood test done, and it showed that she had low white blood cells and low platelets, even though they told us she was perfectly healthy.

Obviously, we didn't get her spayed and decided to take her to our regular vet. They didn't refund the money for the spaying (where they didn't even remove the uterus, just the ovaries), and she also didn't have all the vaccinations she was supposed to have. We paid for the rabies vaccine, and today, after taking her back to our vet, we saw that she hadn't received it.

You don't give an animal up for adoption if you haven't even given it a checkup, and you don't keep the money for a spaying you didn't do and vaccinations you didn't administer.

My dog ​​would have died if she had been spayed without the proper medical examination.
The team is wonderful.
The best veterinary service in Barcelona 10/10
Wonderful! And they even collaborate with animal rescuers 😍😍😍 …
Kindness and trust, is what is shown to all animals. Good service
Very good experience with my cat Luigi❤️🙏🏻 …
Thank you very much!
They are my trusted veterinarians. Highly professional and friendly, everyone we've dealt with has been wonderful. I recommend them 100%.
Excellent service, very friendly and very good professionals.
Our trusted veterinarian
Very professional treatment. We are delighted.

I had my dog ​​spayed and had a gastroplexy performed. Everything was perfect. The service was excellent. All the staff were lovely. They explained everything perfectly so you knew exactly what the operation would involve. I highly recommend them.
Professional and very friendly. You can tell they love the dogs.
Very good professionals and close to me

Besides being bad veterinarians, they have no empathy for their clients.
I was just waiting to be seen when a guy came out of the consultation room with his dog. Apparently, his own dog had bitten him, and they hadn't even bothered to bandage him or treat the wound. His finger was bleeding profusely.
Luckily, another client was waiting and took some gauze out of her bag and treated him right there. 😳😳

Highly qualified and responsible staff. I have a 15-year-old Chihuahua, and the care he's received so far has been exceptional. After bad experiences at other veterinary clinics, I can say that this is a great place for pets.

I called to go to the emergency room with my cat and they treated me very quickly, the vet explained everything to me very well. My little one is already receiving treatment and improving. Super grateful!!
Excellent professionals, great care for both pets and clients. 100% recommended 👌. …

I took my dog ​​in for a checkup, and the vet didn't even give him a full examination. She just said they would take samples to send to the lab. When the results came back, they told me he was positive for leishmaniasis and prescribed two things to buy at the pharmacy. Since I didn't feel comfortable with that vet, I took him to a more specialized and better one. They told me he tested negative for leishmaniasis and that he had an infection in his right ear. Terrible service and poor management at the clinic. I don't recommend it.

Besides, the animal shelter that vet works with, Nerea, didn't handle the adoption of our dog properly.
Good care for animals, they saved our dog's life

My name is Hector Marin, and I brought my cat Trufa here because we weren't happy with the service at another clinic. It's much better here (except for Alfonso and the secretary). Alfonso was very serious, curt, and unfriendly. The secretary was also very serious and curt, and sometimes quite unpleasant. They should improve in this area. On the other hand, the other veterinarians are very friendly, and we like it when we get one of them.

That's why I'm giving it 3 stars.

Regards, Hector Marin

Bulma died that same night, without a diagnosis. The blood work came back normal, and I think the vet, Patricia, didn't find anything serious during the examination. The same thing happened with our dog, Wiskey, on February 6th. Everything seemed normal, but we went to the vet because he suddenly wasn't walking well. Based on the x-ray, they said it was a hip problem. They gave him a painkiller and an injection for arthritis, and we scheduled him for another x-ray and a dental cleaning on Monday. He also died that same night.

If you could help me by sending me the cremation receipts for both of them from your vet's office, since you haven't sent them to me. I requested the receipt for Wiskey when we took Bulma in three months ago. Thank you.
